items.question: For which trip durations does this service offer automatic discounts on hourly package bookings?
items.gold: Bookings lasting between 4 and 10 hours, or up to a specific mileage, whichever comes first.
items.fact: Hourly package discounts apply to bookings of 4 to 10 hours

items.question: Is a scheduled (LATER) booking a guaranteed booking?
items.gold: Yes, it is a guaranteed booking that must be made in advance.
items.fact: Scheduled LATER bookings are guaranteed and must be made in advance
